comments.value: The use case for this, in this case, was to add a script which would overwrite the VRCCam position and size when this particular avatar is being built.
Would be great. Too bad it's stuck in canny hell
@{5cb356e014314c03a61797c7|full_name}: It actually requires considering all parents of the GameObject in question as well, but yes.

details: When a non-whitelisted component is found on a GameObject marked as EditorOnly, the SDK does not allow you to build an avatar. The SDK should allow this but strip the game object (and therefore component) off during upload.
title: Custom components are not allowed on EditorOnly-tagged GameObjects
